data.name: Amyali
data.gender_notes: Amyali is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Amyali is derived from the Arabic word 'Amyl' meaning jasmine. Jasmine is a night-scented flower known for its beautiful and intoxicating fragrance. It is a symbol of beauty, grace, and sweetness. This name is a tribute to the enchanting and captivating essence of jasmine. The name Amyali carries the meaning “Night-scented Jasmine” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Amyali usually hope their child will grow to embody night-scented jasmine and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Amyali signifies the presence of the sweet fragrance of jasmine in one's spiritual being. It represents the beauty and grace of the soul, and the sweetness and elegance of one's inner self. It is a reminder to always strive to be beautiful, graceful, and sweet in thoughts, words, and actions.
data.etymology: Amyali belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night-scented Jasmine.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amyali total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
